mapper.update: update user set username = #{userName}, password = #{password}, useraddress = #{userAddress}, userold = #{userOld}, usersex = #{userSex}, userdescription = #{userDescription}, userState = #{userState}, avatarURL = #{avatarURL}, tipOffNum = #{tipOffNum}, favorIndex = #{favorIndex} where userId = #{userId}
mapper.select: select * from user where username like concat('%', #{userName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
select userId, userName, userAddress, userOld, userSex, userDescription, userState, favorIndex,avatarURL from user where userId in (select userId from follower where followerId = #{followerId})
select userId, userName, userAddress, userOld, userSex, userDescription, userState, favorIndex,avatarURL from user where userId in (select followerId from follower where userId = #{userId})
select userId, userName, userAddress, userOld, userSex, userDescription, userState, favorIndex from user where tipOffNum = #{tipOffNum}
